entities.summary: Mary Anne Theisen-Lappen is an American weightlifter who made history at the 2018 American Open, setting a new record in the 75 kg category. Born in 1987 in Des Moines, Iowa, Theisen-Lappen began weightlifting at the age of 15 and quickly rose through the ranks, winning several national titles and setting multiple records in the process. Her success on the platform has inspired a new generation of female weightlifters, paving the way for greater representation and opportunities in the sport. Theisen-Lappen's achievements have also garnered her recognition from the International Weightlifting Federation, which has recognized her as one of the top female weightlifters in the world. Despite her success, Theisen-Lappen remains humble and dedicated to her craft, continuing to push the boundaries of what is possible in the sport. As she looks to the future, Theisen-Lappen is expected to remain a dominant force in the world of weightlifting, inspiring others to pursue their passions and reach new heights.
